# Kinetic by Windstream

> > Kinetic provides fiber internet, digital TV, and phone services with Wi-Fi 7 and eero Pro 7 technology across Georgia, Alabama, and other regions.

Kinetic is Windstream's consumer broadband brand offering gigabit fiber internet plans, bundled services with AT&T Wireless promotions, and advanced home networking solutions. The site includes service availability by location, support resources, billing information, and regulatory compliance documentation.

## Key Topics

- Fiber internet
- Gigabit internet service
- Wi-Fi 7 technology
- eero Pro 7 mesh networking
- Kinetic Secure Plus
- High-speed broadband
- Residential internet plans
- AT&T Wireless bundles
- Digital TV service
- Georgia and Alabama coverage
- FCC compliance and tariffs
- Internet service provider (ISP)
- Windstream services
- Fiber-to-the-home (FTTH)
- Home phone service
